theater: 洞庭湖水域與沅州、鼎州沿岸

battle.name: 鐘相
battle.theater: 洞庭湖水域與沅州、鼎州沿岸
battle.brief: 一一三〇年建炎四年春，洞庭湖漁民鍾相在沅州一帶聚眾起事，殺州縣吏卒、掠取府庫，舟師一度遮蔽湖面；同年鍾相兵敗身亡，餘眾推楊么為首，據洞庭湖設水寨、造車船，與南宋官軍相持五年，至一一三五年秋為岳飛所破。卡面的希臘火不在這個戰場，當年湖上放火靠的是火藥箭、猛火油櫃與火炬。

kit.name: 希臘火
kit.history: 配在銅管裡的燃燒劑。配方是帝國的機密，配方和船一起沉了。

countries: 這是一場發生在南宋境內的官民對抗，時間橫跨一一三〇年（建炎四年）至一一三五年間，交手的一方是以鍾相、楊么為首的洞庭湖起義軍，另一方是南宋朝廷調集的荊湖官軍。起義軍的主體是洞庭湖周邊的漁民、船戶與沿湖流民，其中也混有北渡之後散在江南的潰兵、逃卒與被裁汰的鄉兵，首領世代以漁船為家，對官府括船、括丁與月糧之徵積怨多年。官軍方面由中樞調度，以湖南、湖北兩路宣撫司與提刑司所部州兵為骨幹，禁軍在鄂州、岳州一線屯駐，戰前又把江浙、淮南調來的民船與團練鄉兵編入水軍，舟師主力壓在長江中游與洞庭湖的出口水道。雙方同屬一個王朝內部的戰爭，起義方沒有外來兵員與外國干涉，這在評估雙方戰力時是相當關鍵的一點。
countriesEn: This was a civil war inside the Southern Song, fought between the Dongting Lake insurgents led by Zhong Xiang and Yang Yao and the Jinghu imperial armies raised by the Song court, and it ran from 1130, the Jianyan fourth year, to 1135. The insurgent ranks were made up above all of the fishermen, boatmen and landless migrants who lived around Dongting Lake, mixed in with soldiers scattered across Jiangnan after the fall of the north, deserters and discharged local militia; their leaders lived on fishing boats and their long-standing grievance lay in the state's requisition of boats, of men for the fleets and of monthly grain levies. On the government side the Central Court directed the operation, with the provincial troops of the Jinghu circuit's pacification and inspection offices as the backbone, the imperial guard garrisoned around Ezhou and Yuezhou, and, before the fighting began, river boats and locally raised militia from Jiangzhe and Huainan were folded into the war fleet, whose main strength was concentrated in the middle Yangtze and at the outlets of Dongting Lake. Both sides belonged to the same dynasty, and neither side received foreign troops or outside intervention, which is a decisive point when weighing their relative strength.
people: 起義的發動者是鍾相。他是洞庭湖上的漁民，平日以捕魚、駕船為業，在沅州、鼎州一帶的漁戶中頗有號召力，一一三〇年春聚眾起事，很快打出水面旗號，殺害州縣吏卒、掠取府庫糧械，舟師一度遮蔽湖面。官軍第一次進剿之後，鍾相兵敗身亡，其部眾隨即推舉楊么為首。楊么接掌後把起義軍整編成一支以舟船為本、能在湖汊中長期活動的水軍，並在鼎州、沅州之間的湖汊與洲渚上設水寨，造車船、造撞山船，與官軍周旋五年。朝廷方面，紹興三年樞密院事張浚奉命經制荊湖，調岳飛所部入湖南主戰；岳飛以行軍統制的名義率前鋒舟師入湖，先敗後勝，最終在洞庭湖中攻破楊么水寨。岳飛之子岳雲亦隨軍參戰。內廷方面，秦檜對岳飛獨斷深入頗有非議，起義軍與金人往來一事更被拿來作為掣肘的藉口。地方上，許多漁民受雇為嚮導，姓名多不見於史籍。
peopleEn: The man who set the rising in motion was Zhong Xiang. A fisherman on Dongting Lake who made his living catching fish and steering boats, he had real authority among the boat households of the Yuzhou and Dingzhou shore, and in the spring of 1130 he called together a following, raised the banner on the water, killed county officials and clerks, seized stores of grain and weapons, and for a while covered the lake with his fleet. After the first government campaign against him he was killed in defeat, and his followers immediately raised Yang Yao to lead them. Yang Yao reorganised the movement into a water force whose base was the boat, able to stay for years in the lake's creeks, and set up stockades among the channels and sandbanks between Dingzhou and Yuzhou, building wheeled boats and ram vessels, and he kept the court at bay for five years. On the government side, in the third year of the Shaoxing era the Privy Council's Zhang Jun was ordered to take charge of Jinghu and sent Yue Fei's troops into Hunan to do the fighting. Yue Fei led the vanguard fleet into the lake in the capacity of a field commander, was beaten at first and won in the end, and finally broke Yang Yao's stockades in the waters of Dongting. Yue Fei's son Yue Yun also served in the campaign. At court, Qin Hui objected to Yue Fei's independent advance into the lake, and the correspondence between the insurgents and the Jin court was used as a pretext to rein him in. Locally, many fishermen were hired as guides, though their names seldom appear in the records.
kits: 卡面上的希臘火是拜占庭帝國的招牌裝備：相傳七世紀末君士坦丁堡的工匠卡利尼科斯試成了這種灌在銅管、用虹吸管推出的燃燒劑，最初用在帝國與阿拉伯人爭奪地中海的帆船密集的海戰裡，噴出的液體能把帆布與船板一次點燃，澆上海水即可熄滅，配方因此列為帝國最高機密，配方隨失火或沉船的戰船一同消失。這套器材與一一三〇年的洞庭湖沒有任何直接關係，兩地相隔萬里，中間沒有可追溯的技術往來；本場衝突中真正在湖面上放火的，是宋人自己的東西：火藥箭、盛猛火油的油櫃、浸油火炬與火船，起義軍與官軍在水道上互燒船隻時用的都是這一類燃燒手段。雙方真正成建制的兵器是水戰裝備：起義軍有楊么所造車船，船側裝水車明輪，轉向靈活，兩舷附撞角，船上設樓棚供弓弩手射擊；官軍仿造同型車船應對，並保有樓船、鬥船等舊式戰船。步卒裝備為弓弩、標槍、長矛、藤牌與木盾，近身靠戈、刀；水寨用木柵、拒馬與木橛，糧秣靠漁獲、掠奪與湖上屯墾。
kitsEn: The Greek fire on the card is the signature equipment of the Byzantine Empire. According to tradition, a craftsman of Constantinople named Kallinikos worked out in the late seventh century this burning mixture poured into copper tubes and forced out through siphons; it was first used in the crowded sailing battles the empire fought with the Arabs for the Mediterranean, the liquid setting canvas and planking alight in a single stroke and dying out again under seawater. The formula was therefore the empire's highest secret, and it went down with the warships that burned or sank. That apparatus has no direct connection whatever with Dongting Lake in 1130: the two places are thousands of miles apart and no traceable line of technical contact runs between them. What actually burned on the lake in this conflict was of Song manufacture: gunpowder arrows, oil jars filled with naphtha, oil-soaked torches and fire ships, and these were the burning devices used by both the insurgents and the government fleet when they set fire to each other's boats on the waterways. The formed fighting equipment on both sides was naval. The insurgents had the wheeled boats built by Yang Yao, with paddle wheels along the sides, free in manoeuvre, iron-shod rams at the bow and raised galleries for crossbowmen; the government fleet built boats of the same type to answer them while keeping older classes of vessel such as tower ships and fighting galleys. On shore the infantry carried bows and crossbows, javelins, spears, rattan shields and wooden shields, with halberds and sabres at close quarters; the stockades used wooden palisades, cheval-de-frise and sharpened stakes, and grain came from fishing, plunder and cultivation on the lake.
tactics: 起義軍的戰術核心是水上游擊與分割。船隊多泊在蘆葦、洲渚與河汊交錯處，官軍舟師一入湖汊便被切成數段；夜裡用小艇靠近泊處，以火箭、火炬灌油焚燒官軍糧船與棧船，順風順水退走。楊么的車船與撞山船則用來正面撞毀官軍樓船——船首包鐵的撞角撞擊船舷，一次即可使大船失去操縱能力，岳飛初入湖時即因此受挫。水寨以木柵、拒馬與淺灘阻隔官軍步兵接近，寨內儲糧，使官軍無法速戰速決。官軍的應對是先陸後水：屯兵潭州、沅州，築城壘扼住洞庭與長江的接駁口，切斷起義軍的糧源與逃入長江的路線；以漁民為嚮導熟悉水道，摸索水寨位置；再仿造車船逆流而上，以撞角對撞角，消耗楊么的水寨；同時把主要任務定為誘楊么出湖——只要把起義軍從熟悉的水寨引到開闊湖面，官軍的車船與弓弩就能發揮。一一三五年的決戰即循此思路：官軍深入，水寨攻破，楊么出湖迎戰，舟師在湖心被衝散。
tacticsEn: The insurgent method was built on waterborne harassment and on dividing the enemy. The fleets lay hidden among reeds, sandbanks and the branching creeks of the lake, so that a government squadron once inside those channels was cut into several parts; at night small boats would close on the enemy's anchored ships, burn grain junks and stores with fire arrows and drenched torches, and drift away on wind and current. Yang Yao's wheeled boats and ram vessels served a different purpose, striking the government's tower ships head on: an iron-shod ram against a hull could rob a large vessel of its control in a single blow, and Yue Fei was checked this way on his first entry into the lake. The stockades were protected by palisades, chevaux-de-frise and shoals that kept the government's infantry from closing, and grain was stored inside them so that the campaign could not be hurried. The government answered by working on land first and on water second: troops were posted at Tanzhou and Yuzhou, forts and stockaded camps were raised on the mouths where Dongting meets the Yangtze to cut the insurgents' supply and their road back into the great river, fishermen were hired as guides to learn the waterways and the sites of the stockades, and boats of the same wheel-driven type were built to drive up-stream against the insurgents, matching ram against ram. The plan of campaign was in essence to lure Yang Yao out of the lake: once the insurgents were drawn from the water they knew onto open water, the government fleet of wheeled boats and crossbowmen could make itself felt. The decision of 1135 followed that logic: the government drove deep in, the stockades were broken, Yang Yao came out to fight, and the fleet was scattered in open water.
data: 關於數字，史料留下的多為約數。起義軍在鼎盛時被記為數萬甚至二十餘萬，但湖區漁民多數只在季節性捕魚時上船，真正能列陣作戰的兵船遠低於此；官軍方面以岳飛所部為主，投入兵力在數萬之數。戰役自一一三〇年春起至一一三五年秋止，前後約五年，其中一一三三年的一次湖上交鋒是關鍵轉折，此後官軍再未放棄進剿。舟船數量方面，起義軍在水寨中屯有船數百艘，一一三五年水寨攻破後官軍收繳與俘獲的舟船亦達數百艘，連同兵器、糧秣不計其數。地理尺度上，十一世紀的洞庭湖水面遠大於今日，枯水期仍有兩千五百平方公里上下，加上四周的河汊、洲渚與蘆葦地帶，縱深可達數十公里，縱橫作戰極為有利。糧道方面，官軍自長江轉運至沅州、鼎州再分送湖邊營壘，運輸全部依靠船隻；起義軍則以湖產與掠奪維持，冬季漁汛一過，糧食供應便顯得緊張。
dataEn: As for the figures, what the records preserve is mostly approximation. The insurgents at their height are given as several tens of thousands, even as more than two hundred thousand, but most lake fishermen only took to the water in the fishing seasons, and the fighting strength that could actually be drawn up was far below those numbers; on the government side the main effort was Yue Fei's command, with a total force in the tens of thousands. The conflict ran from the spring of 1130 to the autumn of 1135, some five years, and the exchange on the lake in 1133 was the turning point after which the government never again relaxed the pressure. As for the number of vessels, the insurgents held several hundred boats in their stockades, and after the stockades fell in 1135 the government recovered and captured several hundred craft, with weapons and provisions beyond count. In geographical terms the surface of Dongting Lake in the eleventh century was far larger than today, still on the order of two thousand five hundred square kilometres even in the dry season, and with the surrounding creeks, sandbanks and reed flats the depth of the fighting ground stretched for tens of kilometres in every direction, which favoured manoeuvre of the widest kind. On the supply side the government moved grain down the Yangtze to Yuzhou and Dingzhou and then distributed it to the camps along the shore, all of it carried in boats; the insurgents subsisted on the lake's fishing and on plunder, and once the winter fishing season ended their food supply visibly tightened.
cause: 起義的直接背景是靖康之變後的南渡。北方淪陷，宋室南遷，禁軍主力北調，留給江南的兵額極度空虛，州縣的秩序要靠團練與鄉兵維持，彈壓力不足。同時，徽宗以來江南民間的反抗傳統並未消失，方臘起義雖在一二二一年被平，其散兵游勇與被沒籍的百姓散入兩浙、江西、湖南一帶，構成起義軍的人力來源。湖區特有的生計矛盾更是直接的導火索：洞庭漁民賴湖為生，卻要承受官軍索取船隻、徵用漁民充作水軍力役、按戶交納月糧三重負擔，遇上災年漁獲減少，繳納便無從著落。建炎末年至紹興初年江南連續歉收，米價騰貴，官府卻在軍費壓力下加緊搜括。南渡之後朝廷為籌措軍糧曾大舉括舟，洞庭一線漁船被徵集無數，漁民抗徵遂成聚眾起事的直接導火索，鍾相於是打出反對括船、拒納月糧的旗號。
causeEn: The immediate background to the rising was the move of the court south after the Jingkang disaster. The north had fallen, the Song court had shifted south, the main body of the imperial army had been sent north, and the troop quotas left to Jiangnan were so thin that the peace of the prefectures and counties rested on locally raised militia, with little power to repress. At the same time the tradition of popular resistance in Jiangnan had not died with the twelfth century: although the Fang La rising was put down in 1121, its scattered soldiers and the people it had dispossessed drifted into Zhe, Jiang and Hunan, and they supplied the manpower of the new revolt. The economic contradiction peculiar to the lake country was the more immediate spark. Dongting fishermen lived off the water, yet they bore three burdens at once: the taking of their boats by the authorities, the impressment of fishermen into the fleets as oarsmen and soldiers, and the monthly grain payment demanded from every household; in a bad year, when the catch fell off, the levy simply could not be met. From the end of the Jianyan era into the early Shaoxing era the harvests in Jiangnan failed year after year and the price of rice soared, while the offices, pressed by the cost of the war, tightened their exactions. After the move south the court requisitioned boats on a large scale to gather military grain, and countless fishing craft along Dongting were taken in; resistance to that requisition was the spark that set the crowds together, and Zhong Xiang raised his banner against the taking of boats and the levying of grain.
impact: 起義雖被鎮壓，其餘波卻長遠。對湖南而言，洞庭湖區的漁業秩序與政治格局被重塑：受降與潰散的水軍兵船部分被編入官軍水籍，漁民被就地招撫為寨兵、水軍，湖上治安自此長期由官設的水軍巡檢把持，洞庭不再是官府完全管不到的空白。對南宋中央而言，這場戰爭證明了南渡之後的江南並不安寧，也展示了岳飛這類能戰之將的價值：洞庭之捷後，岳飛在軍政上的地位迅速上升，隨即被調往襄陽一線籌劃北伐，兵力與地盤都獲得擴張；與此同時，反對者以楊么交通金人一類的理由牽制岳飛，顯示朝廷內部對南線用兵與主戰派將領之間的張力。戰亂造成湖區人口流散、漁戶破產，部分漁民淪為盜匪，為此後湖區的多次流民浪潮留下隱患。
impactEn: Although the rising was crushed, its after-effects were long. For Hunan the fishery order and the political map of the Dongting region were reshaped: men and boats from the surrendered and scattered water forces were enrolled in the government's fleets, fishermen were settled on the spot as stockade troops and boatmen, and order on the lake passed for the long run into the hands of official water patrols, so that Dongting was no longer a blank space beyond the reach of the administration. For the Southern Song court the war proved that Jiangnan after the move south was not peaceful, and it displayed the value of a commander such as Yue Fei: after the victory on Dongting his standing in the army and at court rose quickly, he was moved to the Xiangyang front to plan a northern campaign, and both his troops and his base grew. At the same time his opponents used the sort of pretext of the insurgents' dealings with the Jin to hold him back, showing the strain between the court's handling of the southern front and its commanders who wanted to fight the enemy. The fighting scattered the population of the lake country and ruined fishing households, and some fishermen turned to piracy, leaving a standing danger for the later waves of migration in the region.
result: 結局是起義軍被徹底壓平。鍾相於一一三〇年第一次進剿中兵敗身亡，楊么接掌後把殘部整合成洞庭最大的水上武裝，維持了約五年的割據局面；一一三五年的決戰中，官軍攻破水寨、封鎖湖汊，楊么出湖迎戰，舟師被衝散，楊么本人死於亂軍，部眾或死或降，殘餘首領事後陸續被剿平。官軍收繳與俘獲舟船數百艘，兵器與糧秣堆積如山，張浚以平賊之功上報朝廷。起義軍在湖面留下的殘部被解散歸農，少數被編入官軍水軍，這支在水上磨練出來的力量最終成了南宋在長江中游的一支可用之兵，而它的首領與它的水面都成了岳飛軍功簿上最鮮亮的一段。起義本身的失敗並不等於湖南湖區的恢復平靜，官軍接收水寨之後，巡檢、寨兵與水籍三套編制把洞庭的每一段水道都置於朝廷眼皮之下，此後百餘年，江南再未出現能與鍾相、楊么相比的水上民軍。
resultEn: In the end the insurgents were wiped out. Zhong Xiang fell in the first government campaign of 1130, and Yang Yao, taking over, welded the remnants into the largest armed force on Dongting and held a semi-independent position for some five years. In the decisive action of 1135 the government broke the stockades and closed the creeks, Yang Yao came out of the lake to fight, his fleet was scattered, and Yang Yao himself died in the rout; his followers were killed or surrendered, and the surviving leaders were hunted down one after another. The government recovered and captured several hundred boats, with weapons and provisions piled up like hills, and Zhang Jun reported the suppression of the rebels to court. The remnants of the lake force were disbanded and sent back to the fields, with a small number taken into the government fleets; the strength honed on the water in five years of fighting ended up as a usable force for the Southern Song in the middle Yangtze, while its commander and its stretch of water became one of the brightest passages in the record of Yue Fei's achievements. The defeat of the rising did not mean that the lake country of Hunan returned to quiet: once the government took over the stockades, the triple system of patrols, stockade troops and water registers placed every reach of Dongting under the court's eye, and for more than a century afterwards no waterborne popular force in Jiangnan arose to compare with Zhong Xiang and Yang Yao.
